schema.name: conversations
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE conversations (
		id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
		owner_conversation_id INTEGER,
		owner_task_id INTEGER,
		record TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(record))
	) STRICT

schema.name: conversations_by_owner_conversation
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX conversations_by_owner_conversation ON conversations (owner_conversation_id, id)

schema.name: conversations_by_owner_task
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX conversations_by_owner_task ON conversations (owner_task_id, id)

schema.name: document_revisions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE document_revisions (
		document_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
		seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
		kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('base', 'delta')),
		version INTEGER NOT NULL,
		content TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(content)),
		PRIMARY KEY (document_id, seq)
	) STRICT

schema.name: document_revisions_by_kind
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX document_revisions_by_kind ON document_revisions (document_id, kind, seq DESC)

schema.name: documents
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE documents (
		id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
		kind TEXT NOT NULL,
		family INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (family IN (0, 1)),
		key_value TEXT NOT NULL,
		scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope_kind IN ('session', 'conversation', 'task')),
		owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
		created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
		retired_at INTEGER,
		record TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(record))
	) STRICT

schema.name: documents_by_address
schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX documents_by_address
		ON documents (kind, scope_kind, owner_id, family, key_value, created_at DESC, retired_at)

schema.name: documents_by_scope
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX documents_by_scope ON documents (scope_kind, owner_id, id)

schema.name: documents_by_scope_kind
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX documents_by_scope_kind ON documents (scope_kind, owner_id, kind, id)

schema.name: durable_metadata
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE durable_metadata (
		singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
		next_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		next_seq INTEGER NOT NULL
	) STRICT

schema.name: durable_schema
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE durable_schema (
			singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
			version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0)
		) STRICT

schema.name: entries
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE entries (
		id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
		conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
		head INTEGER,
		commit_seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
		record TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(record))
	) STRICT

schema.name: entries_by_conversation
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX entries_by_conversation ON entries (conversation_id, id DESC)

schema.name: entry_heads_by_conversation
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX entry_heads_by_conversation ON entries (conversation_id, id DESC) WHERE head IS NOT NULL

schema.name: record_ids
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE record_ids (
		id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
		record_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (record_type IN ('conversation', 'entry', 'task', 'submission', 'document'))
	) STRICT

schema.name: submissions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE submissions (
		id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
		conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
		request_id TEXT,
		status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('queued', 'placed', 'done', 'unanswered')),
		record TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(record))
	) STRICT

schema.name: submissions_by_conversation
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX submissions_by_conversation ON submissions (conversation_id, id)

schema.name: submissions_by_request
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX submissions_by_request ON submissions (conversation_id, request_id)

schema.name: submissions_by_status
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX submissions_by_status ON submissions (status, id)

schema.name: tasks
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE tasks (
		id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
		conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
		kind TEXT NOT NULL,
		status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'running', 'waiting', 'completing', 'terminal')),
		abort_requested INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (abort_requested IN (0, 1)),
		background INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (background IN (0, 1)),
		record TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(record))
	) STRICT

schema.name: tasks_by_abort_requested
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX tasks_by_abort_requested ON tasks (abort_requested, id)

schema.name: tasks_by_background
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX tasks_by_background ON tasks (background, id)

schema.name: tasks_by_conversation
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX tasks_by_conversation ON tasks (conversation_id, id)

schema.name: tasks_by_kind
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX tasks_by_kind ON tasks (kind, id)

schema.name: tasks_by_status
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX tasks_by_status ON tasks (status, id)
